basic_info.description: 185-187 Carl Street represents a truly SF-only experience: the opportunity to purchase a vacant-at-close, vintage Victorian 6BD/3BA Duplex w/a 3R permitted 3rd Guest Room w/Cooking in coveted Cole Valley, ideal for investment, an owner-occupied hybrid, or as a family compound, and make it your own! This 1900 classic, which measures 4,025 Sq Ft per tax records, includes 2 large, light-filled flats w/spacious layouts, high ceilings, 2 FPs each, flexible configs, warm hardwood floors, and period detail throughout. The bldg. also includes a roomy Jr. 1BD Guest Room w/Cooking on the ground floor, and bonus basement space w/potential for expansion (buyers to verify all uses & expansion potential). The bright top-floor flat spans the bldg.'s length and features a FLR w/FP, FDR, 3 ample BDs, split BA, large eat-in kitchen w/adjoining laundry room, and stairs to rear yard. The middle flat offers a similar setup w/FLR, FDR, 2 ample BDs, split BA, and roomy kitchen w/laundry & yard access. The Jr. 1BD Guestroom w/Cooking includes LR, sleeping alcove, kitchen, and BA. A large basement w/bonus rooms for hobbies/storage, plus a big backyard for gardening, pets & play, complete this rare offering near Cole Valley's coveted shops, cafes, UCSF, G.G. Park, Haight St., & EZ public transit access.
